siteName: Gale Crater — Murray Buttes & Vera Rubin Ridge

provenance.datasetName: Mars MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m v3
provenance.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA PDS
provenance.instrumentOrMission: MRO HiRISE + CTX + Mars Express HRSC + MGS MOLA reference
provenance.processingPerformed: Bounded 3.84 km x 3.84 km subset (x: 8141500..8145340, y: -282340..-278500) downsampled from 1.0 m native grid to 30.0 m common analysis grid.
provenance.resamplingMethod: Stratified block-mean aggregation (2 x 30 = 60 native 1 m samples averaged per 30 m cell)
provenance.limitations: Downsampling from 1 m to 30 m removes meter-scale rover hazards and boulders while aligning spatial support with Copernicus GLO-30; vertical heights are relative to MOLA Areoid, not Earth EGM2008.
